annotations.title: utilpeek: replace PII with stable keyed tokens (pseudonymise)

description: utilpeek: Pseudonymise PII in text: stable keyed tokens for emails, phones, cards, IBANs and IPs. Returns the text with each email, phone number, payment card, IBAN, US SSN, IPv4 / IPv6, EVM / BTC address and secret URL query value replaced by a typed token (EMAIL_843eca1f055c), plus the token-to-type list with counts. The token is HMAC-SHA256 under your key of the normalised value, so the same value and key give the same token on every call and memory records stay linkable. Same detectors as /v1/text/redact. Pseudonymisation, not anonymisation: the key holder can test guesses. Names and street addresses are not detected. Key never stored or logged. Typically under 1 s. Price: USD 0.002. No free tier. The submitted text is never logged or stored.

key.description: Your secret, 16-1024 UTF-8 bytes. The same key always gives the same tokens; keep it private (whoever has it can test guessed values). Never stored, logged or echoed. Use a long random key kept for this use only.
